mapper.select: select count(*) from information_schema.tables where table_schema = database() and table_name = #{tableName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select id as noticeId, title as title, content as content, create_time as createTime from announcement order by create_time desc limit #{limit,jdbcType=INTEGER}
select count(*) from found_item where audit_status = 1 and status in (0, 1)

select found_id as foundId, title as title, found_time as foundTime, found_location as station, status as status, item_image as itemImage from found_item where audit_status = 1 and status in (0, 1) order by create_time desc limit #{offset,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{pageSize,jdbcType=INTEGER}
